defaults.listing_vs_guide: period-stamped roundup => listing (+ series_key); timeless => guide
defaults.legacy_offer_expiry: extracted end date, else publish_date + 90 days (proposed, needs decision)
defaults.legacy_event_expiry: extracted ends_at, else publish_date + 30 days (proposed, needs decision)

categories.name: News
alternates: type stay/hotel dominates (Pan Pacific, Citadines, Swiss-Belhotel, Club Med)
event/* when the news announces a dated happening
categories.notes: Format is certain; type is per article — the biggest single bucket (356 Yoast-primary) and the most heterogeneous. Location defaults to the site node.

categories.name: Dining Offers
categories.decision: Legacy offers have no campaign row, so `campaign.ends_at` (the §8.A hard filter) is undefined. Recommend: E1.8 extracts an end date from the text where present, else marks the offer expired at publish_date + 90 days. Offers must never surface in rails once expired; they remain searchable.
categories.notes: 33 co-occur with Stay Offers = hotel F&B packages; the venue is still the restaurant/outlet, so type stays eat. 134 of 402 are from 2019 — all expired.

categories.name: Events
alternates: subtype per article: festival | concert | exhibition | performance | screening | sports | community | conference | pop-up
categories.notes: Type and format certain; subtype per article. `ends_at` must be extracted (324 tribe_events rows carry dates; the rest need text extraction) or the §8.A event-expiry filter has nothing to bite on.

categories.name: Dining News
alternates: format people for chef interviews (William Wongso)
type event/festival for food festivals (Jakarta Dessert Week)
categories.notes: Matches the §4 worked example.

categories.name: Stay Offers
alternates: subtype resort | villa | serviced-apartment when explicit
categories.notes: Type/format certain. Location is per article and often OUTSIDE Jakarta (Puncak, Surabaya, Bandung, Malang) — do not default to jakarta. Same expiry problem as Dining Offers.

categories.name: Art
categories.decision: Approve the proposed `editorial/culture` subtype. Without it, exhibition reviews and artist profiles have no home except `news` or `people`.
categories.notes: 244 posts, 165 from 2019. Topic art is the only certain facet; type/format split roughly between dated events and commentary.

categories.name: Reviews
alternates: drink/rooftop-bar or drink/wine-bar when the venue is a bar ('Hakkasan Jakarta Rooftop', 'Good Wines, Good Times')
categories.notes: 152 of 230 are from 2019 — the 18-month half-life sinks them correctly without deleting them.

categories.name: Experience Offers
categories.decision: Is 'Experience Offers' a stay category (hotel packages) or a do category (activities)? Evidence says hotel experience packages (staycations, festive programmes, kids' activities at ARTOTEL/Novotel/HARRIS). Recommend prior stay/hotel + offer, classifier may switch to do/* or event/*.
categories.notes: 10 co-occur with Bali Updates (Bali hotel packages -> location bali). Audience family is frequent but not universal.

categories.name: Business
alternates: format news for appointments and expansions ('Subendi to Lead Surabaya Oakwood')
format opinion for columns ('Why Indonesian Companies Keep Failing to Change')
categories.notes: 122 of 186 from 2019. Type/subtype solid; format per article between feature/news/opinion.

categories.name: Education
alternates: event/community + event for open houses and tryouts
categories.notes: Heavily school-sponsored (BINUS, ACG open houses) — these schools are E1.5 partner-roster candidates, not just content.

categories.name: Explore Indonesia
alternates: stay/resort + offer for hotel promos filed here ('Pullman Ciawi Vimala Hills')
categories.notes: Location per article under `other/*` (Makassar, Yogyakarta, Belitung, Central Java) with `other` as the fallback when the destination has no node.

categories.name: Community
alternates: event/community + event for charity balls and fundraisers (BWA Jakarta)
format feature for initiatives ('The Living Wall')
categories.notes: Topic community is certain; type/format split between dated charity events and features.

categories.name: Opinion
categories.decision: Approve the proposed `opinion` format (half-life 540 d). Fallback if rejected: format feature (evergreen) — which would keep 2019 columns permanently fresh.
alternates: topic sustainability for the 'Sustainability Matters' column
categories.notes: 148 posts, 86 from 2019.

categories.name: Bali Updates
alternates: type stay/resort|hotel dominates (Six Senses, Sofitel, InterContinental, TRIBE)
format news OR offer — roughly half each
categories.notes: Location bali is certain and the §4 example. §4 also says format news, but the titles are as often offers ('Enchanting Year-End Escape', 'Chic Beachfront Picnic Experience') — format per article. These 111 articles are the syndication set for now_bali (§3.5). 92 have Yoast primary = Bali Updates.

categories.name: Shopping
alternates: format guide ('The Groom's Guide to Bespoke Style')
misfiled civic pieces exist ('Civic Engagement 3.0') -> classifier override
categories.notes: Mostly fashion/brand news; treat type as a prior, not a rule.

categories.name: Health
categories.decision: Is 'Health' a venue category or a subject? Evidence is ~50/50: venue pieces (Siloam Hospitals -> wellness/clinic, Celebrity Fitness -> wellness/gym, Sepik -> wellness/spa) vs service journalism ('Are You Really Fit for Work?'). Recommend: topic health always; type per article — wellness/* when a venue is the subject, else editorial/lifestyle (proposed) + feature.
categories.notes: Depends on approving `editorial/lifestyle`.

categories.name: NOW! People
categories.notes: Dormant: 64 of 99 from 2019, 3 since 2024. Evergreen format per §4.

categories.name: World Traveller
categories.decision: Approve the proposed `international` location root. `location` is a required facet and 115 articles (World Traveller + part of Travel) are about Singapore, Australia, Bhutan, Hong Kong. Children can be added once E2.1 reports the destination distribution.
categories.notes: 82 of 94 from 2019. Evergreen format.

categories.name: Uncategorized
categories.decision: No prior at all — the classifier decides every facet. Also contains non-editorial pages ('Order Form - NOW! Magazines'). Recommend: every Uncategorized post goes to the E2.8 review queue regardless of confidence, and E1.8 flags obvious non-articles for exclusion below the quality floor.
categories.notes: 83 posts = the 1.7% 'uncovered' in ARCHITECTURE §6 (WP assigns Uncategorized when nothing else is chosen).

categories.name: History & Heritage
alternates: location kota-tua | menteng | gambir when the piece is about a place
eat/street-food + heritage for food-heritage pieces ('Betawi Satay')
categories.notes: Evergreen. One misfiled promo ('The Maj Senayan') -> classifier override.

categories.name: Culture
categories.notes: Textiles, books, magazines, dance — coverage of culture that is neither an event nor a venue.

categories.name: Sports & Activities
categories.decision: Three different things share this category: spectator/charity fixtures (Asian Tigers Golf Tournament -> event/sports + event), participatory venues and clubs (Urban Climbers -> proposed do/sports-activity), and features about sport (traditional sports, Asian Games -> editorial/culture|lifestyle + feature). Recommend approving `do/sports-activity` and letting the classifier pick among the three.
categories.notes: 44 of 61 from 2019.

categories.name: Offers
alternates: event/conference + offer for MICE pieces ('Bekasi Means Business')
categories.notes: The parent category used directly since 2020 (55 posts); overwhelmingly hotel festive packages. Location per article (Bandung, Gading Serpong, Kuningan, PIK). Same expiry problem as Dining Offers.

categories.name: Music
alternates: editorial/culture + feature for scene pieces ('Hollywood in Jakarta')
event/festival for We The Fest / Papandayan Jazz Fest
categories.notes: 38 of 49 from 2019 — all expired events; the 14-day half-life plus ends_at expiry handles them.

categories.name: Green Living
alternates: editorial/lifestyle + guide ('Going Green in Jakarta: Recycling, Composting...')
categories.notes: Exactly the §4 worked example: a topic, not a type. Topic is certain; type and format per article.

categories.name: Kids & Family
alternates: do/attraction + guide ('Jakarta for Kids', Taman Safari)
categories.notes: Exactly the §4 worked example: an audience, not a type.

categories.name: Made In Indonesia
alternates: location per article when the maker is placed (North Sumatra coffee)
categories.notes: Local makers and brands. Type shop/artisan when a brand or product is the subject (most), else editorial/people. Nationwide -> root node `indonesia`.

categories.name: Film
categories.decision: Approve the proposed `event/screening` subtype (film festivals are the majority: 100% Manusia, Festival Sinema Prancis, Europe on Screen, Balinale). Fallback if rejected: event/festival.
alternates: editorial/culture + review for film reviews ('Daly City')
categories.notes: 28 of 35 from 2019.

categories.name: Art & Culture
categories.notes: Parent category used directly since 2023 (28 posts, 26 Yoast-primary). Only the topic is inferable; everything else per article.

categories.name: Bar Guide
categories.decision: §4 maps this to format guide, but the titles are mostly year-stamped roundups ('The Best Cocktail Bars in Jakarta ... (2026)', '8 Best Beer Bars') plus bar news/reviews. Recommend the boundary: period-stamped roundup = `listing` (540 d, series_key dedup); timeless = `guide` (evergreen). Confirm this definition — it decides whether 2019 roundups stay evergreen.
alternates: format news (openings: 'OZONE Bar & Karaoke is Now Open!')
subtype cocktail-bar | pub | rooftop-bar per article
shop/boutique + news for product pieces (Manta Spiced Rum)
categories.notes: Type drink is certain.

categories.name: Design
categories.notes: Depends on approving `editorial/culture`; topic design is the certain part.

categories.name: Dining
alternates: format listing for '[Updated]' series ('New Restaurants in Jakarta 2026') + series_key
format guide for timeless roundups ('Breakfast in Jakarta')
categories.notes: Parent category used directly since 2023 (24 posts). Type certain; format per article. Contains recipes ('The Rice Table Recipe #5') which have no §4 format — low volume, recommend editorial/lifestyle + feature rather than a new format.

categories.name: Discover Jakarta
alternates: editorial/city-guide + city-guide for neighbourhood pieces (Kemayoran, Jatinegara)
do/attraction + guide for places (Jakarta Library, Taman Doa)
location per article: gambir | kota-tua | menteng ...
categories.notes: Parent category used directly since 2023 (24 posts, all Yoast-primary). Heritage-heavy; location often resolvable to a neighbourhood.

categories.name: Travel
alternates: location other/* or international per article
categories.notes: Parent category used directly since 2023 (21 posts).

categories.name: Features
alternates: subtype per article: culture | heritage | people | opinion | business
topic per article: architecture, heritage, culture, local-brands
categories.notes: Parent category used directly since 2024 (20 posts). Format feature is certain (print-style long-form); subtype per article.

categories.name: City Guides
categories.decision: Naming trap: these are venue roundups ('Best Shopping Malls in Jakarta', '10 Best Spas in Jakarta', 'Things to do in Jakarta (2024)'), not destination guides. Recommend: NOT format city-guide; type = the roundup's venue type per article (shop/mall, wellness/spa, do/attraction); format guide, or listing when year-stamped. Confirm.
alternates: do/attraction + listing ('Things to do in Jakarta (2024)')
categories.notes: 14 of 19 since 2024 — this is the current SEO-listicle programme.

categories.name: Restaurant Guides
categories.decision: Same guide-vs-listing boundary as Bar Guide. 'New Restaurants in Jakarta 2025 [Updated]' and the Chinese New Year roundup are period-stamped -> `listing` + series_key; 'Destination Dim Sum' is a timeless `guide`. §4's worked example says guide for the whole category.
alternates: format listing + series_key for '[Updated]' and seasonal roundups
format news ('BIKO Group's Next Round Begins', 2016 awards)
categories.notes: Type certain. 13 of 17 since 2024.

categories.name: Hidden Heritage
alternates: location: Kalimantan (Punan), Sulawesi (Makassar), Maluku (Banda, Seram), Belitung, Lombok — most have no node, so `other` is the honest fallback
categories.notes: All 16 from 2019-2020; child of Explore Indonesia. Exposes a tree gap: `other` has city nodes but no regional nodes (Kalimantan, Maluku, Papua, Sulawesi). Evergreen format.

categories.name: Lifestyle
categories.notes: Parent category used directly since 2023 (13 posts); a grab-bag.

categories.name: Sites & Destinations
alternates: format heritage for history-led pieces (Istiqlal, Cathedral, Immanuel Church)
location per article: gambir | kota-tua | west-jakarta
categories.notes: 12 posts since 2024, each about ONE landmark — prime E2.3 place-extraction input (places, not just articles).

categories.name: Diplomatic Relations
alternates: event/conference + event if the Round Table is treated as a dated event
categories.notes: 11 posts since 2024, 9 are the 'Ambassadors Round Table' series -> series_key candidate.

alternates: indonesian food; type eat per article
